title: recipe/v1
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of an AIP-63 site recipe manifest (RECIPE.md). The property set is closed: an unknown top-level key is a load error, never a silent ignore (P2). The tool prefix rule (P3) and the workflow prefix rule (P4) are normative prose, not expressible here because each composes with the recipe id.

id.description: Recipe id. Also the directory name (P1) and the base of the tool prefix (P3).

api.description: The recipe API version this recipe targets. A host MUST refuse an api it does not know.

sites.description: Non-empty registrable domains, lowercase. The recipe's origin guard covers each domain and its subdomains exactly as C2 does for grants (P8).

accounts.description: Optional subset of sites. The recipe needs an Account (C17) on these sites (P5, P11). A subset relation is not expressible in JSON Schema; the loader checks it.

tools.description: Exact set of tool names the entry returns (P6). Every name starts with the recipe's tool prefix (P3, prose).

workflows.description: Exact set of workflow ids the entry returns (P6). Every id starts with `<id>-` (P4, prose).

writes.description: Tool name to write gate level (P5, P9, P10). Every tool not listed is a read.

probes.description: Exact set of probe ids the entry exports (P6, P15).

publisher.description: Who publishes the recipe. Shown in discovery and in the guide's provenance.

domain.description: An explicit lowercase registrable domain or host (at least two labels, ASCII or punycode). No wildcard, no leading dot, no bare TLD. A schema cannot see the Public Suffix List, so a host MUST additionally reject public suffixes at runtime (C2).

toolName.description: Generic AIP-14 tool name shape. The recipe id prefix rule is prose (P3).
